name: send_dtmf
description: Send DTMF keypad tones to navigate IVR automated phone menus during a live call. Use this when you hear a pre-recorded voice asking you to press a number (e.g. 'Press 1 for English', 'Press 2 for sales', 'For product inquiry press 3'). Pass the digit(s) you want to press. Also use this if you want to try pressing 0 to reach an operator.

digits.description: The DTMF digit(s) to send. Usually a single digit like '1', '2', '0', '*', '#'. Can also be multiple digits like '1234' for extension numbers.

call_sid.description: The telephony call identifier. This is automatically available as {call_sid}.
